title_pt: Nectar — Sistema de Marca e Eventos
summary_en: A warm, modern identity for a honey-based skincare line — scaled from print to event presence.
summary_pt: Uma identidade moderna e acolhedora para uma linha de cosméticos à base de mel — escalada de impressos a presença em eventos.
approach_en: Geometric bee/honey cues, soft contrast palette, modular print toolkit; event kiosk explored in 3D for fast approval.
approach_pt: Referências geométricas de abelha/mel, paleta de contraste suave, kit modular de impressão; quiosque de evento explorado em 3D para aprovação rápida.
outcome_en: Cohesive touchpoints with strong shelf and event visibility.
outcome_pt: Pontos de contato coesos com forte visibilidade em prateleiras e eventos.
body_en:
## Design Process

The Nectar brand required a delicate balance between natural authenticity and premium positioning. The logo combines geometric hexagon patterns reminiscent of honeycomb structure with clean, modern typography.

## Print Collateral

We developed a comprehensive print system including product brochures, seasonal Christmas cards, and large-format event banners. Each piece uses the warm honey-gold color palette with strategic white space to convey premium quality.

## 3D Event Kiosk

To visualize the event presence before production, we created detailed 3D renders of the brand kiosk. This allowed the client to approve spatial design and material choices with confidence.

testimonial.author: Sarah Mitchell
testimonial.quote: Ventura transformed our brand identity into something truly memorable. Fast, professional, and creative.
